property_summary: For any call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether and with block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference contract only sends its full balance back when block.number is divisible by 15; the mutant sends on block.number divisible by 10 instead, so there exist block numbers (divisible by 10 but not 15) where the mutant transfers but the reference does not.
change_summary: Change the conditional to trigger transfer on a different block multiple (use 10 instead of 15) so transfer behavior differs (single-statement rewrite of the if condition).
